subject.title: Allow before_agent_start hooks to override prompt

question: Should an installed plugin with prompt-injection permission be allowed to replace user-authored prompt text, and if so what precedence and audit semantics must every agent harness enforce?
rationale: The change grants plugins authority to silently alter user intent and expands a shipped plugin API across several runtimes; source inspection cannot determine the intended trust and observability boundary.

options.title: Approve constrained replacement
options.body: Add a shared replacement field gated by allowPromptInjection, use deterministic first-wins precedence with evolved effective state, expose the mutation in diagnostics, and implement parity across all harnesses.

options.title: Reject plugin replacement
options.body: Keep hooks additive and solve oversized current prompts through core-owned overflow detection, blocking, or an explicit user-visible retry/truncation flow instead.

recommendation.title: Approve constrained replacement
recommendation.body: Add a shared replacement field gated by allowPromptInjection, use deterministic first-wins precedence with evolved effective state, expose the mutation in diagnostics, and implement parity across all harnesses.
